summary: These black sesame cookies are not your average treat—earthy, nutty, and so satisfying! Whether you're a sesame fan or new to it, you'll love these.
steps: In one bowl, mix flour, baking soda, and salt.
Then add tahini, vanilla, and an egg.
Now gently mix in the dry ingredients.
Scoop the dough onto a tray and chill for 30 minutes.
Flat in each one with a glass and bake at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 10 to 12 minutes.
